notes.title: DevNote9 - Combat Hit Impact Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, this is OddOneGames.

In this dev note, we’d like to introduce the improvements we’ve made to enhance the [b]impact and feedback of combat.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36585467/56d84182e2fc5233c9fdc9dd75816a2928c536b6.jpg[/img](Ah! Not there!)

Through these updates, we aimed to deliver a[b] better sense of weight and satisfaction[/b] when battling monsters.
The video below was recorded within the editor during development, so the frame rate may be lower, but we wanted to share the direction we’re taking with these improvements.

[previewyoutube=_AqFQ8kGDAI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[h3][*] Hit Freeze Implementation[/h3]
    - When an enemy is hit, there’s a brief 0.1 second freeze.
    - This momentary pause emphasizes the impact of the hit, making each strike feel stronger and more noticeable.

[h3][*] Whitening Effect Added[/h3]
    - The struck enemy briefly flashes brighter upon being hit.
    - This makes it easier to confirm whether your attack connected, and helps identify which enemy was hit in the middle of a group.

[h3][*] Precise Hit Sensation [/h3]
    - To deliver a satisfying hit feeling, [b]visual, sound, and timing[/b] must align perfectly when the player lands an attack.
    - We’re continuously fine-tuning hit range, distance, and timing to perfect this aspect.

[h3][*]Hit Effect Update[/h3]
    - The visual effects triggered on hit have been replaced with sharper, clearer effects.
    - This upgrade improves the texture and immersion of combat moments.

[h3][*] Damage Font Animation Update[/h3]
    - Before: Damage numbers floated upward.
    - Now: Numbers pop out from the target’s body and fall down.
    - This makes the damage numbers easier to notice and visually harmonizes better with the hit effects.




We will continue to refine combat feedback and deliver even more satisfying gameplay through ongoing improvements and player feedback.

Our dev team actively monitors feedback via the Steam community and Twitter comments, so feel free to reach out to us anytime!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@oddonegames]https://www.youtube.com/@oddonegames[/url]

[url=https://x.com/playtreeoflife]https://x.com/playtreeoflife[/url]

Thank you!

notes.title: DevNote 6 - Construction and Destruction
notes.content:
Hello, this is OddOneGames.
Spring is here, and it's time for a big spring cleaning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36585467/9fb3f3af52b1867f0f87f8c651fb0ae252bbaa94.jpg[/img]


[h2]This week, we have some exciting news about houses![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36585467/ccd6026feb49d623fc285e77c7d89c2d00907f11.jpg[/img]


[b][h3]First, let's talk about interior decoration.[/h3][/b]
Have you cleaned up your house? Then it's time to decorate!
[previewyoutube=EHDhwc1n0_k;full][/previewyoutube]
Once you've gathered materials from various sources, you can either craft interior decorations yourself or purchase them from other players.
You can place and move items freely to design your indoor space just the way you like.
Additionally, a wall decoration feature has been added, allowing certain items to be placed on walls for display.




[b][h3]Second, building destruction is now implemented.[/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=ajZrgAoldDs;full][/previewyoutube]
As some of you may know, Tree of Life 2 allows you to choose between PvP and PvE servers.
If you opt for PvP, don't assume your house will always be safe.
Powerful enemies might come and "clean up" your home as if they were bulldozing it to the ground.

Too scary? Feeling anxious? Don't worry! We have a special charm that makes your house indestructible for just $10…

Just kidding! Haha.
The video above is simply a test showcasing the feature.
In the actual game, houses won't be destroyed that easily, so there's no need to worry!


That's all for today's update. We'll be back with more exciting news next time!


Our development team actively checks comments on the Steam Community and Twitter, so if you have any questions, feel free to ask anytime.
https://www.youtube.com/@oddonegames

https://x.com/playtreeoflife

Thank you!

notes.title: DevNote 4 - Cooperative Features in Tree of Life 2
notes.content:
Hello, this is Odd One Games.

We are continuously working on features related to in-game communities.
In online games, interactions with other players are inevitable, and being able to effectively convey emotions is crucial.
Our key focus is [b]cooperation[/b], and we are exploring various actions that players can perform together.


[h3][b]1. Cooperative Building[/b][/h3]
The first feature, which we introduced in a previous update, is cooperative building.
Although it wasn’t shown in the video, building a house with other players is much faster than doing it alone.
Helping others or receiving help is one of the great joys of online gaming.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36585467/7d0122b497c20bde936b4ee5fbfb903063b830e2.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]2. Cooperative Emotes[/b][/h3]
We are working on adding more expressive character animations to enhance the game’s social experience.
One of these features is cooperative emotes, which allow two players to perform an emote together.

When Player A initiates an emote, Player B can interact with them to trigger the cooperative emote.
[previewyoutube=V4rswLVN8rU;full][/previewyoutube]
We are currently preparing cooperative emotes such as handshakes, high-fives, and helping another player up.
If you have any ideas for cooperative emotes, let us know!


[h3][b]3. Cooperative Skills[/b][/h3]
Players will have access to various skills depending on their weapons.
[b]Cooperative skills[/b] enhance player actions and effects when used together.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36585467/71edf985a83074a2474ba45dab8dab77266c2742.png[/img]
For example, the Jumping Mushroom skill allows players to jump high, similar to Mario-style platforming.
This skill can be used in various ways to assist other players.

[list]
[*]The higher you jump before landing, the more damage you deal.
[*]Players can use it to reach areas that would otherwise be inaccessible.
[/list]
When combined with other abilities, this skill creates exciting synergy!


[h3][b]4. Voice-to-Text System[/b][/h3]
Many online players have experienced situations where they type too slowly, only for the other player to leave before they can finish their message.

Since fast communication is essential, we are developing a[b] voice-to-text system[/b] to enable quick chatting.
This feature will be especially useful for players using controllers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36585467/084ac52bb23d3f3b2046a664f0a9cdd0f2af4324.png[/img]


That's all for today! We'll be back next time with more exciting Tree of Life 2 updates!

Our development team actively checks Steam Community and Twitter comments, so feel free to share your thoughts and questions!

Additionally, we’ll be launching a community channel on Oddone Games' YouTube, so don’t forget to subscribe, like, and turn on notifications!

https://www.youtube.com/@oddonegames

https://x.com/playtreeoflife

Thank you!

notes.title: DevNote 3 - Construction System Improvement
notes.content:
Hello, this is Oddone Games.

We’re excited to bring you news about the latest [b]construction system upgrade![/b]

[h1]Construction System Improvement[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36585467/8d60b4e1a9a6f0c4b16a4967b9f3934def6c376d.jpg[/img]
The process of constructing building frameworks has been implemented!

Previously, each module had to be fully built in one step, requiring all necessary materials upfront. This often led to significant losses if mistakes were made during construction.

With this Improvement, the construction system has become [b]more efficient and detailed.[/b]


[h2]Changes & Improvements[/h2]

[b][h3]Build the framework first with fewer materials[/h3][/b]
You can now test different shapes and easily make adjustments before committing to the final structure.


[b][h3]Animated construction modules[/h3][/b]
Enjoy a more dynamic and immersive building process with fully animated construction modules.


[b][h3]Co-op construction support[/h3][/b]
Now you can build together with friends! The more players involved, the faster the construction process. (For example, four players can build four times faster.)


[previewyoutube=zbajdtFSQQM;full][/previewyoutube]



Our development team actively checks Steam Community and Twitter comments, so feel free to share your thoughts and questions!

Additionally, we’ll be launching a community channel on Oddone Games' YouTube, so don’t forget to [b]subscribe, like, and turn on notifications![/b]
https://www.youtube.com/@oddonegames

https://x.com/playtreeoflife

Thank you!

notes.title: DevNote 2
notes.content:
Hello from OddOneGames!

We would like to take some time to talk about the Guardian Stone feature currently in development.

[previewyoutube=jzNYIx7DzIA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What is the Guardian Stone?[/h2]
The Guardian Stone is a system that provides ownership within its area, unlike the "Guardian Tree" from the original Tree of Life. However, it does not offer destruction protection.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th][/th]
        [th]Construction Block[/th]
        [th]Usage Rights[/th]
        [th]Destruction Protection[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]ToL1 Guardian Tree[/td]
        [td]O[/td]
        [td]O[/td]
        [td]O[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]ToL2 Guardian Stone[/td]
        [td]O[/td]
        [td]O[/td]
        [td]X[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]


[h2]How the Guardian Stone Works[/h2]
1. Craft and place the Guardian Stone.
2. When activated (On), its area expands and is displayed on the world map and minimap.
3. All buildings and objects within the area become the property of the player who placed the Guardian Stone.
4. Activating it again will turn it Off.
5. Only the player who originally placed the Guardian Stone can toggle it On/Off.
6. While Off, friends or party members can register themselves (Self-service).
7. Once registered, turning it On grants registered players access to buildings and objects within the area.


[h2]Functions of the Guardian Stone[/h2]
- Prevents monster spawning within the area
- Blocks unauthorized players from placing structures
- Restricts access to doors, gates, storage, etc.
- Blocks access to fields and animals


[h2]Guardian Stone Rules[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36585467/9d0587f54093892d2303cdee39b35cf6d8673502.png[/img]
- New Guardian Stones cannot be placed within an existing Guardian Stone's area.
- Players with permissions can overlap their Guardian Stone areas.
- If two Guardian Stones overlap, only objects within the permitted Guardian Stone can be accessed.
- If a Guardian Stone is destroyed or turned Off, all buildings and objects within its area lose protection and become vulnerable to raids.



The Guardian Stone plays a crucial role in protecting players' and their friends' assets.
As mentioned earlier, the Guardian Stone will not have a destruction prevention feature.
Defense will be managed through structures like walls, and all buildings will be attackable using siege weapons.
However, siege weapons won’t be easy to acquire.
(More details on **Castle Siege** will be shared in a future update.)



[h2]Developer Commentary[/h2]

[h3]From Guardian Tree to Guardian Stone[/h3]
The Guardian Tree in Tree of Life 1 provided strong protection but required high maintenance costs. Additionally, only one could be placed per guild, making it difficult to manage large territories.

Tree of Life 2 introduces the **Guardian Stone** system to overcome these limitations. The Guardian Stone balances defensive effects and lowers maintenance costs, allowing for larger areas to be secured. This adjustment encourages more dynamic combat and territorial battles.

Tree of Life 2 aims to create a more strategic and flexible gameplay environment. We will continue to improve the game for a better overall experience.




Share Your Thoughts!
[h2]Let us know what you think in the comments![/h2]


The development team regularly checks feedback on the Steam Community and Twitter, so feel free to reach out with any questions.

https://www.youtube.com/@oddonegames

https://x.com/playtreeoflife
